title: coworker_deleted_my_lunch_reservation
display_title: My coworker canceled my one bereavement day off — over a parking spot
share_line: Send this to anyone whose coworker weaponized HR against them.
beats: My coworker (31F) canceled my approved bereavement leave through the shared calendar system, and I didn't find out until I was already at the airport (29F).
Three months earlier, I'd started parking in 'her' spot — unassigned, unmarked, just the one closest to the door.
She emailed facilities twice asking for it to be 'formally reassigned' to her. Facilities said no both times.
So the week my grandmother died, she used her team-lead calendar access to mark my bereavement days as 'declined, coverage conflict.'
HR hadn't seen the change. My manager hadn't approved it. I found out from the automated flight-change fee on my card.
I missed the funeral. I flew back the next day and filed a formal complaint with the email timestamps attached.
She got a final written warning. I got my parking spot, unofficially, because nobody wants to stand near her desk now.
My family says I should've let the parking thing go months ago and none of this would've happened. So, Reddit... AITAH?
